/* DgnssMapper.selectEligibleTargetStListForOrd1 */ SELECT gm.stdt_id FROM group_info gi INNER JOIN group_member gm ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE gi.cla_id = #{claId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_other INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_other ON tdri_other.dgnss_id = tdi_other.id WHERE tdi_other.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_other.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_other.cla_id != #{claId} AND tdri_other.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) ORDER BY gm.member_no

/* DgnssMapper.selectEligibleTargetStListForOrd2 */ SELECT gm.stdt_id FROM group_info gi INNER JOIN group_member gm ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE gi.cla_id = #{claId} /* 1회차 이력이 어딘가에 존재해야 함 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_any INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_any ON tdri_any.dgnss_id = tdi_any.id WHERE tdi_any.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_any.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdri_any.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) /* 타학급에서 2회차 이력이 없어야 함 */ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_other INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_other ON tdri_other.dgnss_id = tdi_other.id WHERE tdi_other.ord_no = 2 AND tdi_other.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_other.cla_id != #{claId} AND tdri_other.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) /* 다른 교사의 학급에서 1회차 응시 + 아직 그 학급 멤버인 경우 차단 (같은 교사는 허용) */ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_other1 INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_other1 ON tdri_other1.dgnss_id = tdi_other1.id INNER JOIN group_info gi_other ON gi_other.cla_id = tdi_other1.cla_id INNER JOIN group_member gm_other ON gi_other.group_id = gm_other.group_id AND gm_other.stdt_id = tdri_other1.stdt_id WHERE tdi_other1.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_other1.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_other1.cla_id != #{claId} AND gi_other.host_user_no != gi.host_user_no AND tdri_other1.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) ORDER BY gm.member_no

/* DgnssMapper.selectTargetStudentUserNoList */ SELECT gm.user_no FROM group_info gi INNER JOIN group_member gm ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE gi.cla_id = #{claId} AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND gm.member_type = 'STUDENT' AND gm.user_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gm.member_no

/* DgnssMapper.selectTcDgnssStartPreview */ SELECT gm.stdt_id AS stdtId , gm.nickname AS nickname , gm.member_no AS memberNo
, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_o INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_o ON tdri_o.dgnss_id = tdi_o.id WHERE tdi_o.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_o.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_o.cla_id <> #{claId} AND tdri_o.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) THEN 'BLOCKED_OTHER_CLASS' ELSE 'ELIGIBLE' END AS status
, CASE /* 타학급에서 2회차 이력 존재 */ WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_o INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_o ON tdri_o.dgnss_id = tdi_o.id WHERE tdi_o.ord_no = 2 AND tdi_o.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_o.cla_id <> #{claId} AND tdri_o.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) THEN 'BLOCKED_OTHER_CLASS' /* 다른 교사의 학급에서 1회차 응시 + 아직 그 학급 멤버 (같은 교사는 허용) */ WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_o1 INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_o1 ON tdri_o1.dgnss_id = tdi_o1.id INNER JOIN group_info gi_o ON gi_o.cla_id = tdi_o1.cla_id INNER JOIN group_member gm_o ON gi_o.group_id = gm_o.group_id AND gm_o.stdt_id = tdri_o1.stdt_id WHERE tdi_o1.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_o1.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdi_o1.cla_id <> #{claId} AND gi_o.host_user_no <> gi.host_user_no AND tdri_o1.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) THEN 'BLOCKED_OTHER_CLASS' /* 1회차 이력 존재 (어느 학급이든) */ WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_dgnss_info tdi_any INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info tdri_any ON tdri_any.dgnss_id = tdi_any.id WHERE tdi_any.ord_no = 1 AND tdi_any.paper_idx = #{paperIdx} AND tdri_any.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id ) THEN 'ELIGIBLE' ELSE 'NO_HISTORY' END AS status
FROM group_info gi INNER JOIN group_member gm ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE gi.cla_id = #{claId} ORDER BY gm.member_no

/* DgnssMapper.selectTcDgnssInfoOneWithDgnssId */ SELECT a1.id AS dgnssId , a1.ord_no AS ordNo , a1.cla_id AS claId , a1.tc_id AS tcId , gi.group_nm AS groupNm , gi.host_user_no AS teacherUserNo , a1.dgnss_at AS dgnssAt , a1.paper_idx AS paperIdx , DATE_FORMAT(dgnss_st_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS dgnssStDt , DATE_FORMAT(dgnss_ed_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS dgnssEdDt , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b1.subm_at = 'Y' THEN b1.stdt_id END) AS stSubmCnt FROM tb_dgnss_info a1 INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info b1 ON a1.id = b1.dgnss_id INNER JOIN group_info gi ON a1.cla_id = gi.cla_id INNER JOIN group_member gm ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id AND b1.stdt_id = gm.stdt_id
WHERE a1.id = #{dgnssId} GROUP BY a1.id

/* DgnssMapper.getDgnssReport */ SELECT DAR.SECTION_ID, DS.SECTION_NM, DS.CLASS3, DS.CLASS4, DS.CLASS5, DAR.DEPTH , IF(ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0) < 0, 0, ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0)) AS T_SCORE , IFNULL(DAR.T_RANK, '?') AS T_RANK , IFNULL(DAR.T_SCRIPT, '검사 문항에 충분히 응답하지 않은 경우, 해석 결과를 제공할 수 없습니다.') AS T_SCRIPT , ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.P_RANK,-1) , 0) AS P_RANK , IFNULL(DAR.RANK_TOTAL, -1) AS RANK_TOTAL , IF(IFNULL(ROUND(DAR_FIRST.T_SCORE,0), 0) < 0, 0, IFNULL(ROUND(DAR_FIRST.T_SCORE,0), 0)) AS T_SCORE_FIRST , IFNULL(DAR_FIRST.T_RANK, '') AS T_RANK_FIRST , IFNULL(DAR_FIRST.T_SCRIPT, '') AS T_SCRIPT_FIRST , IFNULL(ROUND(DAR_FIRST.P_RANK, 0), 0) AS P_RANK_FIRST , (CASE WHEN DAR.T_SCORE IS NULL THEN - 1 ELSE (ROUND(DAR.T_SCORE,0) - IFNULL(ROUND(DAR_FIRST.T_SCORE,0), 0)) END) AS T_SCORE_GAP FROM TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA ON DAR.ANSWER_IDX = DA.ANSWER_IDX INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_SECTION DS ON DAR.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA_FIRST ON DA.MEM_ID = DA_FIRST.MEM_ID AND DA.DGNSS_ID = DA_FIRST.DGNSS_ID AND DA.DGNSS_ORD <> DA_FIRST.DGNSS_ORD AND DA_FIRST.DGNSS_ORD = 1 LEFT JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR_FIRST ON DA_FIRST.ANSWER_IDX = DAR_FIRST.ANSWER_IDX AND DAR.SECTION_ID = DAR_FIRST.SECTION_ID WHERE DAR.ANSWER_IDX = #{ANSWER_IDX} AND DAR.DEPTH = #{DEPTH}

(SELECT DS.FACTOR , DS.STUDY , DAR.SECTION_ID , DS.SECTION_NM , IF(ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0) < 0, 0, ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0)) AS T_SCORE , IFNULL(DAR.T_RANK, '') AS T_RANK FROM TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA ON DAR.ANSWER_IDX = DA.ANSWER_IDX INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_SECTION DS ON DAR.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID WHERE DAR.ANSWER_IDX = #{ANSWER_IDX} AND DAR.DEPTH = 5 AND DS.FACTOR = 'PER' AND DS.STUDY = 'STEP' ORDER BY DAR.T_SCORE DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT DS.FACTOR , DS.STUDY , DAR.SECTION_ID , DS.SECTION_NM , IF(ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0) < 0, 0, ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0)) AS T_SCORE , IFNULL(DAR.T_RANK, '') AS T_RANK FROM TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA ON DAR.ANSWER_IDX = DA.ANSWER_IDX INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_SECTION DS ON DAR.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID WHERE DAR.ANSWER_IDX = #{ANSWER_IDX} AND DAR.DEPTH = 5 AND DS.FACTOR = 'PER' AND DS.STUDY = 'BLOCK' ORDER BY DAR.T_SCORE DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT DS.FACTOR , DS.STUDY , DAR.SECTION_ID , DS.SECTION_NM , IF(ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0) < 0, 0, ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0)) AS T_SCORE , IFNULL(DAR.T_RANK, '') AS T_RANK FROM TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA ON DAR.ANSWER_IDX = DA.ANSWER_IDX INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_SECTION DS ON DAR.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID WHERE DAR.ANSWER_IDX = #{ANSWER_IDX} AND DAR.DEPTH = 5 AND DS.FACTOR = 'ENV' AND DS.STUDY = 'STEP' ORDER BY DAR.T_SCORE DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT DS.FACTOR , DS.STUDY , DAR.SECTION_ID , DS.SECTION_NM , IF(ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0) < 0, 0, ROUND(IFNULL(DAR.T_SCORE, -1), 0)) AS T_SCORE , IFNULL(DAR.T_RANK, '') AS T_RANK FROM TB_DGNSS_ANSWER_REPORT DAR INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_ANSWER DA ON DAR.ANSWER_IDX = DA.ANSWER_IDX INNER JOIN TB_DGNSS_SECTION DS ON DAR.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID WHERE DAR.ANSWER_IDX = #{ANSWER_IDX} AND DAR.DEPTH = 5 AND DS.FACTOR = 'ENV' AND DS.STUDY = 'BLOCK' ORDER BY DAR.T_SCORE DESC LIMIT 3)
